subject: Re: Eater NY, Astoria tavern roundup
body:
Hi Julia,

Thanks for reaching out, happy to talk Eleanor's Tavern. The pot roast is my grandmother Eleanor's recipe and it's still the heart of the menu. Grab a slot on my Calendly and stop in any afternoon before service.

Best,
Carlton McGee

subject: Re: Q4 Fish Pricing, proposed numbers
body:
Kevin, confirming the volume commitment in writing so we can lock salmon at $8.90 through Q1. I'll have Ellen note it in the books. Talk Tuesday.

Carlton

subject: Re: American craft wine tasting, fall lineup
body:
Claire, let's lock the Finger Lakes Riesling and two Willamette Pinots. I'll have Daniel pair small plates. Looking at a Saturday in early November for the tasting. Send me a few dates.

Carlton

subject: Re: Astoria Prep, 7th Grade Conferences
body:
Hello, Ellen or I will take a conference slot the week of Oct 12. Afternoons are best before dinner service. Thank you.

Carlton McGee

subject: Re: Spring produce standing order
body:
Hi, let's bump the early greens and asparagus for the spring menu. Daniel will finalize quantities Thursday. Same Tuesday/Friday delivery window works for us.

Carlton

subject: Re: Restaurant Week staffing
body:
Sophia, let's add a second host Friday and Saturday and put Grace and Marcus on the floor. Closed Monday as always. Can you draft the schedule and send it around?

Carlton

subject: Re: Celtics game next week
body:
Dan, grabbed two for the TD Garden game when I'm up in Boston seeing Mom. We can watch the early Sox innings at her place first. Talk soon.

Carlton

subject: Re: Linen service, spring volume
body:
Hi, when the patio opens we'll need the larger weekly napkin and tablecloth count. Please confirm the updated rate and keep the Wednesday pickup.

Carlton McGee

to_addr: Sunday roast at Ellen's parents' - Bayside, 5 PM.
subject: Sunday chess + jazz
body:
Uncle Stuart, come by Sunday afternoon for the jazz set. I'll save the corner table and we can get a couple games in before dinner service picks up.

Carlton

subject: Re: spring newsletter draft
body:
Priya, looks good. Lead with the late-winter tavern specials, then the Restaurant Week prix-fixe, and tease the spring wine series at the bottom. Let's send it to the regulars list this week.

Carlton

subject: Re: Walk-in cooler service call
body:
Hi, the walk-in is holding temp again but I'd like the spring maintenance check before the season picks up. Any morning before 11 works, ideally a Monday when we're closed.

Carlton McGee

subject: Re: June vendor invoices
body:
El, Atlantic Seafood and the produce invoices are in the vendor folder. Salmon's locked at $8.90 with Kevin so the fish line should look steady. Let's reconcile Monday.

C

subject: Re: Rehearsal dinner, back room, 28 guests
body:
Hello, the back room seats 30 so 28 is perfect. We'd build a family-style menu around Eleanor's Pot Roast and a couple of Daniel's seasonal plates, with Hudson Valley wine pairings. Happy to hold your Friday date with a deposit.

Carlton McGee

subject: Re: St. Andrew's fundraiser catering
body:
Father Nicholas, glad to help with the fall fundraiser. We can do a hearty tavern spread and donate a portion of proceeds. Send me the head count and date and I'll work it around our Sunday service.

Carlton

subject: Re: POS settlement timing
body:
Hi, confirming weekend card batches should settle next business day to the operating account. Please verify the deposit schedule so Ellen can match it in the books.

Carlton McGee

to_addr: Alex soccer game Saturday 11 AM - leave the tavern to Sophia.
subject: Montauk Monday?
body:
Thinking of running out to Montauk a Monday this spring when we're closed. Alex wants to come. Need to check the charter and tide table first.

Carlton

subject: Re: Coming up to Boston
body:
Hi Mom, planning a quick trip up this spring. We'll catch a Celtics playoff game and maybe a Sox game if the schedule lines up. The kids want to see you. I'll call Sunday after the jazz set.

Love, Carlton

subject: Re: NY strip and short rib order
body:
Hi, holding our standing strip order steady and bumping short rib for the pot roast through the busy stretch. Daniel will confirm cuts Thursday. Same delivery days.

Carlton McGee

subject: Re: Deep clean, Monday slot
body:
Hi, let's keep the deep kitchen clean on Mondays since we're closed. Please confirm next month's dates so I can let the staff know.

Carlton McGee

subject: Re: Liquor liability renewal
body:
Hi, please send the renewal quote for the liquor liability and general policy. Ellen will review with me before we sign. We'd like to keep the same coverage levels.

Carlton McGee
